summary: Frontend-only mobile web testing completed for DayStack core flows. Most requested flows pass; delete action on Tasks screen is broken in web preview due hidden/non-interactable swipe delete control.

ui_bugs.issue: Delete control is present in DOM but not visible/clickable after swipe attempt on Expo web preview. Could not complete delete flow.

integration_issues.issue: Gesture + delete action fails on web; row opens/edit path instead and delete button stays non-visible for click.

issues: Compact ChoiceChips use minHeight 38, below recommended 44px touch target for mobile accessibility.

react_native_issues.issue: Observed warnings: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' and Animated useNativeDriver fallback warning in web preview.

action_items: Provide a reliable delete fallback for web (e.g., visible delete button/menu) instead of swipe-only behavior.
Increase compact chip touch targets to >=44px height.
Review and clean up runtime warnings (pointerEvents deprecation, Animated native driver fallback where applicable).
critical_code_review_comments: Core architecture is clean and local-storage implementation is appropriate for no-backend requirement.
testID coverage is generally strong and enabled robust automation.
Deletion UX depends on Swipeable gesture; this is brittle on web preview and currently blocks required delete flow verification.
seed_data_creation: Created local test tasks via UI: TEST_QUICK_HOME_1, TEST_ONE_TIME_EDITED, TEST_RECUR_INTERVAL, TEST_RECUR_WEEKDAYS, TEST_FINAL_STATS.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use a fresh browser/storage session if you need deterministic counters in Stats. Existing AsyncStorage data persists between runs.
rca_of_issue: Repro for delete bug: go Tasks tab -> filter recurring (optional) -> attempt horizontal swipe on task row -> delete element appears in DOM but Playwright reports not visible; click fails. Likely Swipeable right action is clipped/hidden in Expo web layout or gesture does not fully reveal action region. Mitigation: add explicit visible delete affordance for web/mobile fallback.
